headline_cluster.headline: יותר מ-300 אלף קולות בוזבזו: המפלגות שנשארו בחוץ
מהפיראטים ועד שרשר המלך: 25 המפלגות שנשארו בחוץ

claims.claim_he_or_en: יותר מ-300 אלף הצביעו למפלגות שלא עברו את אחוז החסימה, 306,172 ליתר דיוק
claims.verified_figure: Sum of the 25 below-threshold lists = 307,899 (Wikipedia "2026 Israeli legislative election" results table, sourced to CEC votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults (counted as of 30 Oct; certification due 4 Nov)); Haaretz (29 Oct, 'count completed') reports 306,679.
claims.note: 'More than 300,000' holds under every source. The exact 306,172 matches neither the CEC-sourced table (307,899, a 1,727-vote gap, 0.56%) nor Haaretz (306,679); likely a different pre-certification count snapshot, but the precise figure is not reproducible.

claims.verified_figure: Invalid/blank votes = 25,988 (Wikipedia "2026 Israeli legislative election" results table, sourced to CEC votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults (counted as of 30 Oct; certification due 4 Nov)); Haaretz reports 25,789 disqualified.
claims.note: Within 5 votes (0.02%) of the CEC-sourced figure; differences of this size are consistent with count updates before the 4 Nov certification. Haaretz's 25,789 is a further 199 lower.

claims.verified_figure: The Reservists - New Economic: 154,995 votes (Wikipedia "2026 Israeli legislative election" results table, sourced to CEC votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults (counted as of 30 Oct; certification due 4 Nov)).
claims.note: Off by 45 votes from the CEC-sourced figure (154,950 vs 154,995 - possibly a digit transposition or earlier snapshot). Immaterial to the conclusion that the list fell short.

claims.claim_he_or_en: 2.72% מהסך הכולל, וחסרו להם כ-30 אלף קולות; הקרובה ביותר ל-3.25% מבין אלו שלא עברו
claims.verified_figure: 154,995 / 5,690,685 valid = 2.72%; threshold 3.25% = 184,947 votes, so shortfall = 29,952. Next-closest below-threshold list: Amcha Yisrael 1.68% (Wikipedia "2026 Israeli legislative election" results table, sourced to CEC votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults (counted as of 30 Oct; certification due 4 Nov)).
claims.note: Percentage, ~30,000 shortfall and 'closest to threshold among those that failed' all match the CEC-sourced table.

claims.claim_he_or_en: עמך ישראל של עופר וינטר קיבלה 95,663 קולות בלבד, 1.68% מכלל הקולות - בערך חצי מהנדרש
claims.verified_figure: Amcha Yisrael: 95,663 votes, 1.68%; threshold = 184,947 votes, so 95,663 = 52% of required (Wikipedia "2026 Israeli legislative election" results table, sourced to CEC votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults (counted as of 30 Oct; certification due 4 Nov)).
claims.note: Exact match on votes and percentage; 'about half of what was needed' is a fair characterization (52%).

claims.claim_he_or_en: הציבור החרדי (לייטנר) וצבע שחור - כל אחת קיבלה מעט יותר מ-10,000 קולות, כ-0.2%
claims.verified_figure: The Color Black 11,274 (0.20%); Haredi Public 10,594 (0.19%) (Wikipedia "2026 Israeli legislative election" results table, sourced to CEC votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults (counted as of 30 Oct; certification due 4 Nov)).
claims.note: Both slightly above 10,000 votes and ~0.2%, as stated.

claims.verified_figure: CEC-sourced table: 36 lists received votes, 11 entered the Knesset, 25 fell below the threshold (plus 2 withdrawn lists - Blue and White, Achi - with 0 votes) (Wikipedia "2026 Israeli legislative election" results table, sourced to CEC votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults (counted as of 30 Oct; certification due 4 Nov)).
claims.note: 25 lists that received votes stayed out; the count would be 27 only if withdrawn lists are included. Article body unreachable (bot-blocked), so only the headline number is judged.

claims.claim_he_or_en: בבחירות 2022 מרצ ובל"ד נשארו בחוץ, יותר מ-417 אלף קולות 'בוזבזו' על מפלגות שלא עברו את אחוז החסימה, וגוש הימין-חרדים הגיע ל-64 מנדטים; הנתון השנה נמוך בהרבה
claims.verified_figure: 2022 (25th Knesset): sum of below-threshold lists = 417,400 of 4,764,742 valid votes; Meretz 150,793 (3.16%) and Balad 138,617 (2.91%) both below 3.25%; Likud 32 + RZ-Otzma 14 + Shas 11 + UTJ 7 = 64 seats (Wikipedia 2022 results table, sourced to CEC). 2026: 307,899 (see c1).
claims.note: All 2022 figures match: >417k wasted votes, Meretz and Balad out, 64-seat right-Haredi bloc. 2026's ~306-308k is indeed substantially lower (about 110k fewer).

claims.claim_he_or_en: במעטפות הכפולות, שכוללות את הצבעת חיילי צה"ל, קיבלה המפלגה (המילואימניקים והכלכלית) 3.87%
claims.verified_figure: Not found. The double-envelope breakdown is published only on the CEC results site (votes26.bechirot.gov.il), which returned 404 to this runner; web.archive.org copies were blocked; no secondary outlet reporting the figure was found.
claims.note: The primary source exists (cited by Wikipedia) but could not be accessed, and no secondary report of the 3.87% figure turned up in Hebrew or English searches.

claims.claim_he_or_en: פילוח יישובי: המילואימניקים - באר יעקב 5.5%, מודיעין-מכבים-רעות 4.8%, כפר יונה 4.6%, ראשון לציון 4.6%, חדרה 4.4%; עמך ישראל - מודיעין 4.1%, גבעת שמואל 7.4%, ירוחם 3.9%, פתח תקווה ויקנעם עילית 2.5%
claims.verified_figure: Not found. Locality-level results are on the CEC per-locality pages (votes26.bechirot.gov.il), unreachable from this runner (404; archive blocked); searches found no secondary report of these figures.
claims.note: Cannot confirm or refute any locality percentage. The ynet text's own internal logic (Amcha Yisrael 'crossed the threshold' only in Givat Shmuel, Modiin and Yeruham at 7.4/4.1/3.9%, all above 3.25%) is consistent, but the numbers themselves are unverified.

primary_source_urls: https://votes26.bechirot.gov.il/nationalresults?lang=en (cited; unreachable directly - 404 from this runner, archive.org blocked)
audit_note: Primary CEC site (votes26.bechirot.gov.il) not directly reachable (404 from runner; archive.org blocked). National figures verified via Wikipedia results table that cites the CEC national results page, cross-checked against Haaretz. All 2026 figures are pre-certification (official results due 4 Nov 2026), so small vote-count differences between sources are expected.
